description: This file contains functions for managing cookies and local/session storage via Playwright, including getting, setting, and clearing cookies and storage data.

methods.name: cookiesGetViaPlaywright
methods.description: Retrieves cookies for a given page context using Playwright.

methods.name: cookiesSetViaPlaywright
methods.description: Sets a cookie in the page context, with validation for required fields.

methods.name: cookiesClearViaPlaywright
methods.description: Clears all cookies in the page context.

methods.name: storageGetViaPlaywright
methods.description: Retrieves local or session storage data, optionally for a specific key.

methods.name: storageSetViaPlaywright
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in local or session storage.

methods.name: storageClearViaPlaywright
methods.description: Clears all data from local or session storage.
